speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I see you are an 8-month-old boy having trouble feeding and your tummy looks swollen. To help me understand what's wrong, can you tell me if you are passing stools or having vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds painful; has there been any passage of "currant jelly" stools or blood mixed with stool recently? Also, have you noticed any high fever?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the exact appearance of the baby's stool, and while we speak, I need to check the abdomen. REQUEST EXAM: Abdominal_Palpation. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound.
